# The screen list — GENERATED by tools/screen-list.cjs from the register. Do not edit; run `node tools/screen-list.cjs`.

Every small-app screen and every sheet has a code (AAA###, assigned once, never reused) and shows it in a chip:
the header for a page or section, the sheet's own title row for a sheet. A tap on the chip copies the code.
Register: `public/app/screen-id.js` (declared rows, merged into `CBSCREENS`) + `public/app/screens.js` (the workshop).
